subject.title: feat(ui): live agent activity subtitles on running sidebar sessions

question: Should this feature retain the proposed default-on synced sidebar activity preference and the accompanying 312 KiB startup-JS ceiling after the shared-subscription repair and real-run proof are supplied?
rationale: The feature introduces both a persistent user setting and a ratcheted startup budget change; the body calls it maintainer-requested, but the supplied discussion does not contain a maintainer decision confirming the final default and budget tradeoff.

options.title: Sponsor default-on behavior after repairs
options.body: Keep the default-on synced preference and 312 KiB ceiling, but require shared subscription ownership, real producer-path proof, and documentation before merge.

options.title: Narrow the rollout
options.body: Require an opt-in or otherwise reduce the default subscription and startup-budget impact before accepting the feature.

recommendation.title: Sponsor default-on behavior after repairs
recommendation.body: Keep the default-on synced preference and 312 KiB ceiling, but require shared subscription ownership, real producer-path proof, and documentation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged adjacent sidebar feature and are the strongest available history-based routing candidate for the intended sidebar behavior.
